# CMDx

> Build business logic that's powerful, predictable, and maintainable.

CMDx is a Ruby framework for building maintainable, observable business logic through composable command/service objects. It brings structure, consistency, and powerful developer tools to your business processes.

## Getting Started

- [Home](https://drexed.github.io/cmdx/index.md): CMDx framework overview, installation, quick examples, and core concepts
- [Getting started](https://drexed.github.io/cmdx/getting_started/index.md): Task setup and framework fundamentals (CERO pattern)
- [Configuration](https://drexed.github.io/cmdx/configuration/index.md): Comprehensive guide to CMDx configuration

## Basics

- [Setup](https://drexed.github.io/cmdx/basics/setup/index.md): Task structure, inheritance, and basic setup requirements
- [Execution](https://drexed.github.io/cmdx/basics/execution/index.md): Task execution methods (execute vs execute!), error handling, and control flow
- [Context](https://drexed.github.io/cmdx/basics/context/index.md): Context object for data sharing, input/output management, and attribute access
- [Chain](https://drexed.github.io/cmdx/basics/chain/index.md): Execution chain tracking for related tasks within threads

## Interruptions

- [Signals](https://drexed.github.io/cmdx/interruptions/signals/index.md): Intentional task interruption using skip! and fail! methods
- [Faults](https://drexed.github.io/cmdx/interruptions/faults/index.md): execute! exceptions for failed tasks with result, task, context, chain, and cleaned backtrace
- [Exceptions](https://drexed.github.io/cmdx/interruptions/exceptions/index.md): Complete exception hierarchy (Error, DeprecationError, ImplementationError, MiddlewareError, Fault) and execute vs execute! semantics

## Outcomes

- [Result](https://drexed.github.io/cmdx/outcomes/result/index.md): Result objects exposing execution state, status, context, and metadata
- [States](https://drexed.github.io/cmdx/outcomes/states/index.md): Execution lifecycle states (initialized, executing, complete, interrupted)
- [Statuses](https://drexed.github.io/cmdx/outcomes/statuses/index.md): Business outcome statuses (success, skipped, failed) and transitions
- [Errors](https://drexed.github.io/cmdx/outcomes/errors/index.md): Structured per-attribute error container accumulated during input/output verification and exposed on result.errors

## Contracts

- [Definitions](https://drexed.github.io/cmdx/inputs/definitions/index.md): Attribute declarations (required/optional), validation, and type coercion
- [Naming](https://drexed.github.io/cmdx/inputs/naming/index.md): Customizing accessor method names with prefixes and suffixes
- [Coercions](https://drexed.github.io/cmdx/inputs/coercions/index.md): Automatic type conversion for inputs (string to integer, date parsing, etc.)
- [Validations](https://drexed.github.io/cmdx/inputs/validations/index.md): Input validation rules (presence, length, format, numeric, inclusion, exclusion)
- [Defaults](https://drexed.github.io/cmdx/inputs/defaults/index.md): Default values for optional inputs (static, dynamic, callable)
- [Transformations](https://drexed.github.io/cmdx/inputs/transformations/index.md): Value transformation after coercion but before validation
- [Outputs](https://drexed.github.io/cmdx/outputs/index.md): Declaring expected context outputs that must be set after task execution

## Hooks

- [Callbacks](https://drexed.github.io/cmdx/callbacks/index.md): Execution lifecycle callbacks (before_execution, on_success, on_failure, etc.)
- [Middlewares](https://drexed.github.io/cmdx/middlewares/index.md): Cross-cutting concerns wrapping task execution (authentication, caching, timeouts)

## Composition

- [Workflows](https://drexed.github.io/cmdx/workflows/index.md): Composing multiple tasks into sequential pipelines with conditional execution
- [Deprecation](https://drexed.github.io/cmdx/deprecation/index.md): Managing deprecated tasks with logging, warnings, or execution prevention

## Resilience

- [Stores](https://drexed.github.io/cmdx/stores/index.md): Shared key/value store for idempotency, rate limits, locks, and cross-worker coordination
- [Locks](https://drexed.github.io/cmdx/locks/index.md): Single-flight leases via Stores so concurrent workers do not run the same logical work
- [Idempotency](https://drexed.github.io/cmdx/idempotency/index.md): Preventing duplicate execution for retried jobs and webhooks with idempotent_by
- [Rate limit](https://drexed.github.io/cmdx/rate_limit/index.md): Admission control per window with fixed-window and leaky-bucket limiters
- [Circuit breaker](https://drexed.github.io/cmdx/circuit_breaker/index.md): Automatic circuit breaking for failing dependencies with threshold, cool-off, and window options
- [Retries](https://drexed.github.io/cmdx/retries/index.md): Automatic retry functionality for transient failures with jitter and selective retries

## Observability

- [Logging](https://drexed.github.io/cmdx/logging/index.md): Structured logging with multiple formatters (JSON, KeyValue, Logstash, Line, Raw)
- [Internationalization](https://drexed.github.io/cmdx/internationalization/index.md): Multi-language support for error messages and validations (90+ locales)

## Adoption

- [Testing](https://drexed.github.io/cmdx/testing/index.md): Best practices for testing CMDx tasks and workflows with RSpec
- [Tips and tricks](https://drexed.github.io/cmdx/tips_and_tricks/index.md): Best practices, patterns, and techniques for maintainable CMDx applications
- [Comparison](https://drexed.github.io/cmdx/comparison/index.md): Comparison with other command/service object frameworks
- [v1 → v2 Migration](https://drexed.github.io/cmdx/v2-migration/index.md): Migration guide from CMDx 1.x to 2.0

## Ecosystem

- [Ecosystem](https://drexed.github.io/cmdx/ecosystem/index.md): Satellite gems (cmdx-i18n, cmdx-rspec)

## References

- [References](https://drexed.github.io/cmdx/references/index.md): API docs, llms.txt exports, and repository AI skills

## Cookbook

- [Overview](https://drexed.github.io/cmdx/cookbook/index.md): Integration recipes for jobs, Rails, auth, observability, and more

## Cookbook: Rails and Active Record

- [Active Record Database Transaction](https://drexed.github.io/cmdx/cookbook/active_record_database_transaction/index.md): Wrap task work in an Active Record transaction
- [Active Record Query Tagging](https://drexed.github.io/cmdx/cookbook/active_record_query_tagging/index.md): Tag SQL queries with task metadata
- [Paper Trail Whatdunnit](https://drexed.github.io/cmdx/cookbook/paper_trail_whatdunnit/index.md): Paper Trail attribution for running tasks

## Cookbook: API and integration

- [GraphQL Resolvers](https://drexed.github.io/cmdx/cookbook/graphql_resolvers/index.md): Resolve GraphQL fields with CMDx tasks
- [OpenAPI Schema Generation](https://drexed.github.io/cmdx/cookbook/openapi_schema_generation/index.md): Generate OpenAPI schemas from task inputs
- [PubSub Task Chaining](https://drexed.github.io/cmdx/cookbook/pub_sub_task_chaining/index.md): Chain tasks from pub/sub events

## Cookbook: Cross-cutting concerns

- [Background Execution](https://drexed.github.io/cmdx/cookbook/background_execution/index.md): Run tasks via Active Job or Sidekiq
- [Store Wrappers](https://drexed.github.io/cmdx/cookbook/store_wrappers/index.md): Test doubles and instrumented store wrappers
- [Flipper Feature Flags](https://drexed.github.io/cmdx/cookbook/flipper_feature_flags/index.md): Gate tasks behind Flipper feature flags
- [Pundit Authorization](https://drexed.github.io/cmdx/cookbook/pundit_authorization/index.md): Authorize tasks with Pundit before work runs
- [Timeout Guard](https://drexed.github.io/cmdx/cookbook/timeout_guard/index.md): Bound task execution time with a timeout guard
- [Sentry Error Tracking](https://drexed.github.io/cmdx/cookbook/sentry_error_tracking/index.md): Report CMDx faults to Sentry
- [OpenTelemetry Tracing](https://drexed.github.io/cmdx/cookbook/opentelemetry_tracing/index.md): Distributed tracing for task execution
